## Maned Wolf (CR 1)

This long-legged canine looks like a cross between a fox and a wolf, but it is neither. It lopes solitarily across the grassland.  

**XP** 200  
N Medium animal  
**Init** +6; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +5  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+5 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 13 (2d8+4)  
**Fort** +5, **Ref** +5, **Will** +1  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft.  
**Melee** bite +3 (1d6+1 plus trip)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 12, Dex 15, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 6  
**Base Attack** +1; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 14 (18 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Perception +5, Stealth +6, Survival +1 (+5 scent tracking); Racial Modifiers +4 Survival when tracking by scent  


**Ecology**


**Environment** open grassland  
**Organization** solitary or pair  
**Treasure** none
